technique_name: Explain the different types of insulation used in buildings.
description: The most common types of insulation used in buildings include fiberglass, spray foam, cellulose, mineral wool, and foam board. Fiberglass insulation is made from glass fibers and is most often used as batts. Spray foam insulation is sprayed into walls and ceilings and provides a tight, air-sealed envelope that is effective in controlling air infiltration.
